label: I q.76 a.1 co. — The human soul is the first principle of the human being’s vital operations
interpretation: Aquinas argues from what a human being first acts by to the form of the one to whom the act is properly attributed. The human being is both the one who understands and the one who senses. Aquinas distinguishes being the body’s form and exercising intellect through a bodily organ.
attribution: The passage states that the human intellectual soul is the form of the body and the first principle by which the human being nourishes itself, senses, moves locally and understands, which is the premise.
